Android automatically removes permissions if you don\'t open the app for a while. On the next screen, turn off the option labelled \"Manage app if unused\", \"Pause app activity if unused\", or \"Remove permissions if app isn\'t used\". If you don\'t see this toggle, look under Permissions. Exact wording and toggle location may vary by device manufacturer and Android version.
Tap a row to grant the permission.

Show the persistent notification when Keep Alive is on.

Wake the device with an exact alarm instead of the system\'s deferred scheduler, which can be delayed by aggressive OEM battery optimization. For best results, allow unrestricted battery usage and grant the Alarms & reminders permission (Android 12+). The deferred scheduler remains active as a backup.

If the system wakes the app late, the send still goes out when it arrives within this window; older occurrences are recorded as missed. A very late send can arrive after the end date of a schedule that ends on a date.
